item.title: See you on Sunday
item.description: We’d love you to join us any Sunday morning at 10 am. Our service involves (among other things) contemporary worship, Biblical teaching and communion. Usually, the children join us at the start of the service, then head downstairs for their own programme, there is a creche available for children under 3 years during the service.

item.title: Combined Service
item.description: On the Sunday after Christmas the 3 Whitby Churches – North Porirua Baptist, St Mary’s Anglican and us, join together for a combined service. This year on Sunday 29 Dec 9.30 am, we are at St Mary’s Anglican Church. We would love for you to join us. Darryl Ward will be looking back to the year that has been and reflecting on the year to come. We’d love you to join us all.

item.title: An exciting leadership step!
item.description: Fifteen years ago, Darryl, Stella and family jumped on the plane in Adelaide and headed in our direction. Since that time Darryl has cared for, pastored and journeyed with us here at the Anchor. His heart of love for both God and us, meant that the news of his decision to retire at the end of 2025, has been sad for us. item.title: 25 years of mainly music
item.description: The dancing, the chatting, the cuppas, the playtimes, the giggles and even the occasional tear or two – it’s all been a part of the amazing mainly music journey over the last 25 years at The Anchor. We’ve been so privileged to make this journey with the many, many families of all shapes and sizes who have joined in the fun in our church gym. item.description: Do you have questions about faith, Christianity, God, life and its direction? You can just have coffee and a discussion based around the Bible and what it states, and think about what our response to that might be? item.title: Divorce Care
item.description: Dealing with Divorce? We offer a 13-week support and practical course for adults dealing with separation and divorce. This programme provides a safe, caring, trusting, open and supportive environment where you can share and move forward finding help, hope and healing in what is a very difficult and challenging time. We have an online course starting Thursday 26 March at 7.30pm. There will be an in-person course later in the year – dates tbc. Find out more here.

item.title: Easter 2026
item.description: This year we’d like to invite you to ‘Come and See’ Easter. Whether you’re familiar with the Easter story or it’s totally new to you, come and discover what it’s all about. We’ll explore some of the themes of darkness and light as we move from the story of the cross to the joy of the resurrection.
